chunks: From him, from ʿAlī, from both of them, from Ibn Muskan, who said:

He narrated to me from one who asked him about a man who performed three circuits of the obligatory tawaf around the House, then found an empty space in the House and entered it. He said: He has invalidated his tawaf and opposed the sunnah, so he must repeat it.

key_terms.خَالَفَ السُّنَّةَ: he acted contrary to the prescribed sunnah
key_terms.خَلْوَةً: an empty or unoccupied opportunity to enter
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf required as part of the rite

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone enters the Ka'bah before completing the obligatory tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning obligatory tawaf during hajj. If a person interrupts the tawaf of obligation after three circuits in order to enter the Ka'bah, his tawaf is invalidated, because this act opposes the sunnah, and he must repeat the tawaf.
